stopPoints.label: Beautiful snowy mountains and forest
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'Look at the trees. Is it sunny ☀️ or snowing ❄️?'
Guidance: 'It's snowing! There is white snow on the trees.'

stopPoints.label: Poby and Harry are sleeping in bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are Poby and Harry sleeping?'
Options: 'A) Yes, they are. B) No, they aren't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they are sleeping!'

stopPoints.label: Poby yawning and stretching
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (TPR): 'Wake up! Let's stretch like Poby!' (The teacher opens arms wide and stretches).
Guidance: Guide the child to copy the action and shout out: 'Wake up!'

stopPoints.label: Harry falling upside down
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action/Position): 'Oh no, look at Harry! Is he standing up or upside down?'
Guidance: 'He is upside down! Silly Harry! Can you shake your body like him?'

stopPoints.label: A little bird sitting on Poby's head
stopPoints.question:
Question (Prepositions): 'Where is the little bird? Is it under the head or on the head?'
Options: 'A) On the head? B) Under the head?'
Guidance: Help the child touch their head and say: 'On the head!'

stopPoints.label: All the friends gathering together on the snow
stopPoints.question:
Question (Counting): 'Wow, so many friends! Let's count them together. How many friends can you see?'
Guidance: Point at the screen and count with fingers: 'One, two, three, four, five! Five friends!'

stopPoints.label: Eddy showing up with his small gray plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object Identification): 'What is Eddy driving? Is it a car 🚗 or a plane ✈️?'
Guidance: 'It's a plane! It has wings and can fly high!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong getting ready to fly
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (Chant): 'Let's help them take off! Let's countdown together!'
Guidance: Lead the child to shout: 'Ready, set, go! 🚀'

stopPoints.label: The plane shaking and losing balance in the air
stopPoints.question:
Question (Movement): 'Oh dear! Is the plane flying up high or falling down?'
Guidance: 'It's falling down! Oh no!'

stopPoints.label: The first plane crashing into a tree branch
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the plane now? Is it in the water or on the tree 🌲?'
Guidance: 'It's on the tree! It crashed into the tree!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong covered in dirt with band-aids
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Look at Pororo and Crong. Are they happy or sad?'
Guidance: 'They look sad 😢. Their faces are dirty and they are hurt.'

stopPoints.label: Eddy showing a brand new powerful blue plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Look! What color is this new plane? Is it yellow 💛 or blue 💙?'
Guidance: 'It's blue! A beautiful, big blue plane!'

stopPoints.label: Friends opening their mouths wide in shock
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (Facial Expressions): 'Look at their faces! Wow!'
Guidance: Put hands on cheeks, open mouth wide, and encourage the child: 'Can you make a surprised face like them? Say: Wow!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo happily hugging the cockpit window
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Do they like the new blue plane?'
Guidance: 'Yes, they do! They love it! Look at Pororo, he is so happy!'

stopPoints.label: The blue plane preparing for a second takeoff
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (TPR): 'The blue plane is going to fly! Zoom!'
Guidance: Move your hand like a plane flying upward and say: 'Zoom, zoom, zoom! Fly away!'

stopPoints.label: The blue plane crashing into a snowy mountain
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object identification): 'Oh no, what did it hit? Did it hit a house 🏠 or a mountain 🏔️?'
Guidance: 'It hit a big, white mountain. Another crash!'

stopPoints.label: Eddy launching an even stronger rocket plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Size Comparison): 'Wow, look at this super plane! Is it small or big?'
Guidance: 'It is very big and super strong!'

stopPoints.label: The rocket plane shooting straight up into outer space
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the plane flying now? Is it in the clouds or in outer space with stars ✨?'
Guidance: 'It's in outer space! Look at the dark sky and stars!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo spotting something strange out the window
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (TPR): 'Pororo sees something! Point to your eyes and say: Look over there!'
Guidance: Shield your eyes with one hand, look into the distance, and encourage the child to copy you.

stopPoints.label: The friends returning and landing safely
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are they back home on the snow?'
Guidance: 'Yes! They are back safely! Yay!'

stopPoints.label: New alien friends stepping out of the ship
stopPoints.question:
Question (Appearance): 'Look at the new friends from space. Do they look the same or different?'
Guidance: 'They look different! They have funny shapes, but they look friendly!'

stopPoints.label: Eddy checking the broken spaceship parts
stopPoints.question:
Question (Status): 'Is the alien ship okay or broken?'
Guidance: 'It's broken because it crashed. Eddy is looking at it.'

stopPoints.label: It gets dark outside and they invite guests home
stopPoints.question:
Question (Time of day): 'Is it morning ☀️ or night 🌙 now?'
Guidance: 'It's night! The sky is dark. It's time to go inside.'

stopPoints.label: Serving fresh cookies on a plate inside the house
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'What is Eddy giving to the friends? Is it pizza 🍕 or cookies 🍪?'
Guidance: 'Yummy cookies! Everyone loves cookies!'

stopPoints.label: The alien friends happily eating the cookies
stopPoints.question:
Interaction (TPR): 'Are the cookies delicious?'
Guidance: Rub your tummy and make eating sounds: 'Nom, nom, nom! So yummy!'

stopPoints.label: Everyone laughing and cheering together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are they all good friends now?'
Guidance: 'Yes! They became great friends instantly! Let's clap our hands for them! 👏'
